newsitem.title: DUBAI: AEI Dubai facility set for January 1 open.
newsitem.headline: AEI Dubai facility set for January 1 open.

text.p: Freight forwarder Air Express International said today its new warehousing and distribution centre in the Dubai International Airport Free Zone will be operational by year-end.
AEI already operates 15 distribution centres around the world.
The Dubai centre, its second in the United Arab Emirates, is one of three additions planned for 1997. New centres will also open in Dublin and Tel Aviv, the company added.
